text:
Chip Fields played **Rochelle**, one of J.J.'s girlfriends, in "J.J.'s New Career, Part 2" (Season 4, aired November 17, 1976), per [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chip_Fields) and [TVmaze](https://www.tvmaze.com/characters/204646/good-times-rochelle). The team note saying Thelma is not supported by these sources, so I'm keeping Rochelle.

CONFIDENCE: 90
